text.title: Ads Analytics Setup Examples
text.summary: Reference schemas the rules assume: standard key events per business type, the UTM parameter schema with naming formats, and an exported UTM constants module.

section.title: Standard key events by business type

list.item: E-commerce key events: purchase, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, view_item
SaaS key events: sign_up, trial_started, purchase, onboarding_completed
Lead gen key events: generate_lead, form_submit, phone_call
Content key events: newsletter_signup, download, content_viewed

section.note: Mark these explicitly as conversions in GA4 Admin (explicit-conversion-marking rule); none of them may reuse a GA4 reserved event name.

list.item: utm_source: traffic origin (google, meta, linkedin, twitter, email, affiliate) — lowercase only
utm_medium: marketing channel type (cpc, paid_social, email, organic_social, referral)
utm_content: ad variation format [type]_[description]_[version] e.g. video_testimonial_v2

example.title: UTM values as exported constants
example.note: Humans never type utm_source by hand (utm-constants-in-code rule); the link builder lowercases campaign and content so spaces and mixed case cannot reach GA4 reports.
